summary: First-finish backend smoke test for KOP 3x3. All 32 checks passed across auth, tournament seeding, player registration (30 players), admin CRUD, team rename, balanced draw, 20 group matches generation, match result points formula (winner=3+min(elims,2), loser=min(elims,2)), perfect flag, standings, playoff auto-generation (semis -> final+third), champion, MVP, stats, match lock (rejects with 400 'Partida bloqueada'), reset, and auth enforcement on all admin endpoints.
passed: 10 teams pre-seeded (5 group A, 5 group B) via /api/teams
POST /api/players/register (30 players, no auth needed, base64 photo)
POST /api/draw without auth -> 403; with auth distributes 30 players into 10 teams of 3
20 GROUP matches generated with status AGUARDANDO
POST /api/matches/{id}/result computes points correctly (5 vs 1) and sets ENCERRADA
perfect_a=true when winner has 0 eliminated players
GET /api/playoffs auto-generates 2 SEMI after group phase complete
FINAL and THIRD auto-created after semis complete
POST /api/tournament/reset without auth -> 403; with auth clears matches
notes: Match documents use fields team_a/team_b (not team_a_id/team_b_id) as per server.py. GET /api/tournament returns the tournament document only; teams are queried separately via /api/teams. Everything works end-to-end.
